principals.name: A
principals.description: The initiator: holds its identity and the long-term symmetric key K_as shared with S; generates N_a, decrypts S's response under K_as, and forwards the ticket to B.

principals.name: B
principals.description: The responder: holds its identity and the long-term symmetric key K_bs shared with S; generates N_b, sends the server request, and verifies the final K_ab-protected confirmation.

principals.name: S
principals.description: The trusted authentication server: holds its identity and both long-term symmetric keys K_as and K_bs; generates the fresh session key K_ab and distributes it encrypted for A and B.

values.name: K_as
values.description: K_as is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.

values.name: K_bs
values.description: K_bs is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.
